authentication.description: X-API-Key header for watch management. Sign up via POST /v1/signup (key shown once, 100 starter credits, email verification required). Check-ins use watch id + check-in key, no API key.

description: The agent that stops checking in IS the one you will hear about. Liveness attestation: register a watch, the agent checks in on schedule, and silence past interval plus grace triggers an alert email and a hash-chained receipt.
limits: Liveness only: never judges what the agent did, only whether it is still there.
One watch per agent per owner.
An owner at 0 credits is skipped for alerts; the watch stays overdue.
name: ForgingStack Watchtower

pricing.note: 1 credit to register a watch, 1 credit per alert, check-ins free. Credit packs: $10 for 1,000 credits via POST /v1/billing/checkout; credits are added once the payment is verified.
